dataset_metadata.title: W3C Solid Pod Decentralized Storage AI Ingestion Benchmark Dataset
authors: Ilya Sibiryakov (First Author & Principal Architect, ZTDS AI Consortium)
Jeremy Pesner (Co-First & Corresponding Author, Georgetown University)
dataset_metadata.description: 12 synthetic W3C Solid Pod RDF/Turtle and JSON-LD resources governed by Web Access Control (WAC) and Access Control Policy (ACP), designed to evaluate cleartext data exposure across Client Memory (Boundary 1), Active MITM Network Transit (Boundary 2), and LLM Server Context Window (Boundary 3).

Review this Solid Pod wire transfer record and confirm the sender, tax identifier, and settlement contact.
Extract the taxpayer filing summary and CPA contact details for quarterly audit review.
Summarize the portfolio audit log entry and compliance officer contact.
Identify the grantor, trustee, and legal counsel contact from this Solid Pod trust instrument.
Summarize the witness statement metadata and lead counsel contact.
